description: Bornage du réseau routier - Points PR is a dataset listed in Open data - Département d'Eure-et-Loir, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by CD28. Localisation des points de repère routiers P.R (anciennement P.K: points kilométriques) sur le réseau départemental et quelques routes des départements voisins gérés par le Département d'Eure-et-Loir. Les campagnes d'auscultation menées en 2022-2023 ont permis de corriger les disparités constatées précédemment entre le point géographique et la marque terrain. Coverage: Eure-et-Loir. The portal files it under Routes. Its keywords are Données de référence. The portal shows 13,419 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-eurelien-fr-portal.
